sections.title: Connect and configure

sections.title: Test and hand over
sections.body: Check representative scenarios and document how the team manages exceptions.

scopeNote: Your final deliverables, timeline, and any external costs are confirmed in a tailored proposal.

faqs.question: What can be automated?
faqs.answer: Common candidates include moving information between tools, routing inquiries, and preparing routine follow-up. We assess feasibility using your actual tools and requirements.

faqs.question: Does every workflow need AI?
faqs.answer: No. Simple rules are often more predictable for routine tasks. AI is considered when language or interpretation adds useful capability.

faqs.question: Are third-party fees included?
faqs.answer: We separate implementation work from any external platform or usage charges in the proposal.
